content:
DJ John Summit’s message to the Grammys after being snubbed in the nominations Monday wasn’t something you can groove to ― but it was memorable.

The electronic dance music artist, who’s known in part for “Where You Are” and “Shiver,” combined profanity, dissing and a boycott ultimatum to vent on X.

“Never submitting to the grammys again unless shit changes, it’s all a fucking joke,” he wrote. “i’m not just talking about myself either there’s zero respect for real electronic dance music & dj’s. the whole dance category is just music industry fueled pop stars.”

Madonna was nominated in both the “Best dance/electronic recording” and “Best dance/electronic album” categories, as was Slayyter and Tame Impala.

“Not saying the artists nominated aren’t good, they’re just not dance music, they’re pop,” he continued. “No dj is playing that music in the clubs.”

Summit shot back at online criticism by writing, “oh no i’m getting attacked hard on here 🤣 time to log off and continue my sold out arena tour for my real fans :)”

The performer sparred online on the same day his tour bus was reportedly involved in a fatal crash in Florida. He was not aboard. The driver and nine passengers were reportedly OK, but the driver of the other vehicle died from the collision after running a red light, TMZ reported, citing a law enforcement source.
